notes.note: Three under 80 now for Sicily as he isn't bringing the season home strongly for us.
Sicily had his lowest of the season with his 18 disposals in the Hawks loss.
Sicily was solid down back and took 8 marks and had 18 but it was his lowest in the last 9 games.
Sicily made the most of the matchup with 10 marks and 27 disposals with 5 being intercept possessions.
Sicily was playing loose in defence this week and racked up 26 disposals and a goal.
15 disposals for Sicily on a wet night that didn't favour the big men.
Sicily's scoring has been bouncing around of late and whilst he had 19 disposals they weren't damaging enough to bring a big score.
Sicily used the footy well this week going at 95% for his 22 disposals and 10 marks.
Just 17 touches and he also gave away a 50m that resulted in a goal which hurt his score. His second in the 70s in the last four games.
Sicily was angry but he still found the footy with 22 touches and importantly 10 of them were intercept possessions which helped boost his score.
Sicily is putting together a very good season as he top scored for the Hawks with 10 marks and 33 disposals at 81%. He is one we are going to have to consider.
Equal lowest score for the year from Sicily from just 11 disposals but he took 6 marks and had 5 tackles.
This was back to back over 100 for Sicily for the first time since the first two games of the season. 23 disposals and 8 marks for the Hawks defender.

Sicily had a good battle with the Docker forward and he had 22 disposals of which 20 were effective and he also had 10 marks. After being under an injury cloud it was good to see a solid score from him.
Sicily was struggling with an ankle issue late in the game and is questionable for this week and possibly the one after.
Sicily had 17 touches and his lowest of the year but he has also been suspended for 1 week for a punch.
Sicily was better this week after a couple of sub 100 scores. He took 13 marks which led the game in that category. He looks to be putting together a very solid start to the season.
Despite this being his lowest this year he has gotten off to a great start this season. This is vintage Sicily and he is putting his name up for us to consider again.
Sicily was great down back taking 11 marks. He isn't one that we need to jump on though.
Sicily tried to lift his team after half time. And it showed as he was the top scoring Hawk by over 30 points! We weren't talking about him but maybe we should be.
